summary: AMTD Digital Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its board approved changing the fiscal year end from October 31 to December 31, effective immediately, to align subsidiary reporting dates with controlling shareholder AMTD Group amid the group's global acquisitions and expansion. No transaction, price, stake or premium is stated. The filing is a routine reporting-calendar change by a foreign private issuer (US equivalent: an 8-K calendar/administrative disclosure), not a special situation; watch for the transition-period 20-F and any group-level acquisition disclosures.
